criteria.description: Scan chain structural rules verified; clocks, resets, and tri-state buses are controllable in shift/capture modes; cite test-mode muxing and scan clock declarations.

Identify and classify fault coverage gaps (Stuck-At, Transition Delay, At-Speed); distinguish untestable faults (tie-offs, redundant logic) from test generation aborts; cite ATPG report summaries and fault lists.
Evaluate test point insertion (control and observe points) for low-observability logic cones without violating functional timing closure; cite inserted test cell instances.
Memory BIST controllers execute test algorithms (March C+/raw), log repair signatures, and report diagnostic status registers accurately; cite MBIST controller state registers.
